title: Orsen and the House
author: Oscar Nakamura
blurb: Odile Thornbury, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
